scope: Thirty original executable DevOps/Python function canaries; bounded local tasks, not SWE-bench or repository-scale agent performance.
completion_policy: Only natural stops graded; all thirty required for full-cohort accuracy.
runtime_fingerprint_policy: Recomputed from each stored identity; content-hashed files exclude reboot-dependent overlay device/inode/mtime values.
